title: Airway management in a patient with Goldenhar syndrome
abstract: Goldenhar syndrome involves multiple facial, cardiac, renal and neurological deficits which generally culminate into difficult ventilation and intubation. Various devices have been reported, in successfully securing the airway of these children. In our case we have preferred CMAC laryngoscope in securing the difficult paediatric airway and have found it effective, safe and less cumbersome than the traditional direct laryngoscopy.
